name: The Great Sump Purge & The Litany of Thunder

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The golden basilica reverberates with triumphant Latinate chants. Confessor Malachi's macro-vox broadcast has filled every corner of the sub-level with pious fire, completely drowning out the warp-bleed static.
The subterranean lair of the Great Sump Horror is caved in under smoking rubble and smoking green ichor. The threat of underground predators has been eradicated; corpse recovery serfs work safely.

new_milestone.title: The Apex Sump Horror Exterminated & Warp Static Banished
new_milestone.consequence: Sergeant Vane granted command autonomy: Confessor Malachi silenced the warp static via the Basilica macro-vox, while Vane and Bragg detonated a Krak Grenade inside the Great Sump Beast, securing the lower sectors.

apex_sump_carnifex.name: Great Sump Chitin-Gorgon (Apex Horror)
notable_kills: Apex Predator: baited by Bone 'ead Bragg, heart obliterated by Sergeant Kathryn Vane's internal Mark IV Krak Grenade detonation

sump_sewer_scuttlers.name: Sump Sewer-Scuttlers

4 Heavy Armored Scuttlers: skull-pulped by Bone 'ead Bragg's Power Fist
Drainage Swarm (37 scuttlers): concentrated lasfire and Trooper Jax's 2 frag canisters

feral_sump_stalkers.name: Feral Sump Stalkers
notable_kills: 5 forward mutant scouts picked off by Bastion Heavy Stubber overwatch during welding phase

krak_grenades.unit: charges (-1 used to slay apex horror)

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: Sub-Level 404 security rating at peak (94%). Food reserves at exactly 3.0 days. Immediate priority: Complete the Macro-Shell tithe batch to trigger Spire emergency supply drop.

new_decision.decision: Broadcasted full autonomy to sector officers over the vox, then descended into the Charnel abyss with Bragg; planted a Mark IV Krak Grenade directly into the belly carapace of the Great Sump Horror, obliterating the beast.
new_decision.impact: Exterminated the root cause of underhive terror and secured Level 404's southern underbelly.

new_decision.decision: Exercised autonomous authority: engaged the Basilica's macro-vox soundbanks to chant the Litany of Sanity at maximum volume, scouring the psychic static from the vox-net.
new_decision.impact: Banished the warp-bleed hallucinations across the entire level without a single casualty.

new_decision.decision: Utilized command autonomy to integrate salvaged brass water valves into the shell-press cooling lines, accelerating the second macro-shell tithe batch by 30%.
new_decision.impact: Brought the level within reach of earning the Spire's emergency supply drop.

new_decision.decision: Grappled the Great Sump Horror's scythe-jaw with his power fist, holding the thrashing monster in place while the Sarge inserted the krak grenade.
new_decision.impact: Suffered acid burns on his armor but ensured the fatal strike was delivered true.
